label: Chat
description: Timestamps, stacked repeats, click to copy and a longer history.
settings_description: Settings for the Chat gameplay mod. Every setting changes how vanilla's own chat (`ChatHud`) stores and draws messages on this client; nothing is sent, and no message anyone else sees is altered. With the mod off the chat is vanilla, byte for byte.
source: ChatHud: message add, line render and history cap; ChatScreen: mouse click

timestamps.description: Whether each message is prefixed with the time it arrived, `[14:03]`, in grey.

stack_repeats.description: Whether a message identical to the one before it replaces it with a count, `(x3)`, instead of adding another line. Lobby spam and repeated server notices collapse to one line.

click_to_copy.description: Whether right-clicking a message in the open chat copies the whole message, without colour codes, to the clipboard.

background_opacity.description: Opacity of the dark band behind chat lines, as a fraction of the line's own fade. 0.5 is vanilla; 0 draws text only.

history_length.description: How many messages the chat keeps for scrolling back. Vanilla keeps 100.
